description: I am Shah Khalid from Peshawar, solo developer. I built Space2Earth - Field Shift, a bilingual Urdu/English app that helps Pakistan farmers save water using NASA climate data. I work in Python, Flask, NASA POWER & Open-Meteo APIs. My team is complete, I am not looking for new members.
summary: Space2Earth is a Python web app in Urdu/English that helps Peshawar farmers choose better crop rotations. Farmers face changing rainfall, heat, water shortage and weak soil. Our app compares the farmer's current rotation with better alternatives like Wheat-Mustard and Wheat-Chickpea. It uses NASA POWER for historical weather, 7-day forecast, heat/frost risk and water balance, plus Open-Meteo for live weather. It shows soil moisture estimate, water need vs rainfall, and what-if sliders for rainfall and temperature. This helps farmers save water, protect soil health, and adapt to climate change. NDVI is estimated only, not real MODIS. SMAP/GPM not yet integrated.
details:
What does it do? Space2Earth compares farmer's rotation with alternatives and tells which rotation is better for soil, water and climate.

How does it work? User selects location Peshawar, crop and rotation. App fetches NASA POWER data for temperature, rainfall, heat and frost, and Open-Meteo for forecast. It calculates water balance, soil moisture estimate, and shows score for each rotation.

Benefits: Saves water, improves soil health, reduces risk from heat and drought, helps farmer plan for next season.

Impact: Small farmers in Peshawar and Pakistan can make data-based decisions instead of guessing.

Tools Used: Python, Flask, HTML, NASA POWER API, Open-Meteo API, PythonAnywhere for hosting, GitHub for code.

Creativity: First Urdu/English tool for local farmers with what-if sliders. Farmer can change rainfall and temperature to see future.

Team Considered: Local weather, local crops Wheat, Maize, Mustard, Chickpea, water shortage, and farmer's low literacy - so simple Urdu interface.
